name: Validate SFX Library
description: Startup check: verifies the SFX library FAISS index exists and is searchable. Does NOT re-run the SFX profiling pipeline — that's a one-time setup. Fails with a clear message if the index is missing or corrupt.

inputs.name: sfx_library
inputs.description: Absolute path to the SFX library. Process-level input, resolved from PIPELINE_SFX_LIBRARY. step.py exits 1 without it, so declaring it here is what makes this entry node runnable at all.

outputs.name: sfx_library_status
outputs.description: What the validation looked at: { valid, sfx_library_path, entries, playable_entries, missing_files, catalog_entries, catalog_entries_described }, plus `error`/`fix` on a refusal. The GATE is the step's own exit code, not this record - see library/tools/output_contract.py.
